purpose: Record additional source-inspected candidate leads for later Java regression screening; do not treat these as red-green-reproduced, independently reviewed, or eligible held-out confirmatory cases.
current_protocol_gate_status: all prospective freeze gates remain pending
model_release_basis: Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct model card indicates a 2024 release/update; these candidate fixes merged in 2026. This lowers exact-fixed-patch exposure risk relative to later public fixes but does not exclude exposure to pre-fix code, related patterns, or other training leakage.

candidates.source_triage_reason: A negative cache entry for one search-domain permutation was treated as authoritative and prevented later search domains from resolving; the fixed logic separates cache probing from the search-domain resolution ladder.
concerns: Validate pinned pre-fix/fixed red-green behavior in the existing screening workflow.
Ensure the causal graph reflects resolver/cache/search-domain components, not merely a same-class call chain.

candidates.source_triage_reason: The OpenSSL key-material path selected key types from cipher-suite auth methods even for TLS 1.3, where client signature algorithms govern the choice; the patch touches key selection and engine protocol detection.
concerns: Red-green reproduction may depend on JDK/OpenSSL provider support and specific runtime prerequisites.
Ensure the actual diagnosis distinguishes signature-algorithm negotiation from certificate-generation/test-provider setup.

candidates.source_triage_reason: Removal through a collection decorator's iterator updated the backing collection but not its MultiMap index, leaving lookup/uniqueness behavior inconsistent. This offers a concrete state relationship between view mutation and an auxiliary index.
concerns: Confirm pre-fix failure and fixed pass from the exact hashes.
Review whether the index/collection relation is a defensible CCDG dependency and not simply data-structure bookkeeping.

candidates.source_triage_reason: The inherited Collection.forEach default traversed the decorated iterator without holding the synchronizing wrapper's lock; the fix guards iteration and propagates the contract to synchronized collection subclasses.
concerns: Potentially more concurrency-contract-focused than a deep root-cause path; independent reviewers may rate CCDG suitability weak.
The test is parameterized across multiple decorator types; preserve one defect as one case rather than counting subclasses as independent observations.

candidates.source_triage_reason: A mutable TimeZone reference was retained/exposed by cached formatter/parser objects, allowing one caller to alter behavior observed by other holders of a supposedly immutable shared formatter.
concerns: Check overlap with other date/time candidates; do not over-represent closely related formatting defects.
Reviewer should decide whether the cache, formatter/parser, and mutable timezone form a cross-component causal path of sufficient complexity.

candidates.source_triage_reason: The decoder accepted back-reference offsets larger than its retained history window; during buffer sliding the reference index could become negative and leak an unchecked array-copy failure instead of a declared compression error.
concerns: The named test directly targets the protected primitive; check which concrete decoders exercise the path and whether the case remains multi-component enough for CCDG.
Avoid counting multiple codec callers as separate cases if one shared root cause is used.

reserve_or_exclude.reason: Mechanism is ambient-locale/non-Gregorian date parsing, closely related to current Lang #1800 lead; avoid over-weighting one defect family until diversity is reviewed.
Pack200 UTF-8 prefix validation sits in the same Pack200/unpack error-handling area as an existing #805 lead; defer until reviewers assess whether both belong in the same defect family.

OrderedProperties key/value view mutations desynchronize backing mappings and order tracking. Promising, but collection-view state consistency is already represented by other Commons Collections leads; reserve to maintain mechanism diversity.

The PR explicitly discloses Claude Code assistance in drafting the code change, tests, and description. Given the project's conservative screening policy, do not promote into the primary held-out shortlist. This is a methodology/source-selection choice, not proof that the frozen 2024 model was trained on the PR.

The identified behavior is primarily the empty-code-length guard in HuffmanDecoder and may be a weak single-component boundary case; do not spend reproduction capacity until a defensible cross-component path is demonstrated.
